metadata.method: Real update/spawn/kill loops with actual enemy HP, ATK, critical resistance, minions, movement, death reset, healing, shields, dots and proc paths. Only old/current playerAttack differs in memory. Headless renderer/FX disabled. New pet drops are removed immediately after the native kill routine (RNG is retained), keeping pets absent; no gained job/Ascension XP during a run. Fixed builds and default six-slot combos, same seeded inputs per pair. Three seeds are exploratory, not confidence intervals. Farm starts at full HP from field entry (no warm-up). Boss trial is independent, includes real minions, and ends at first win/death or the limit. Raw DPS includes overkill; effective DPS caps each hit to remaining enemy HP.
assumptions: GX is a proxy, not the user save: visible base STR120/AGI120/LUK120/DEX16/VIT2/INT1, +15 Infernal katar base chosen to reproduce visible weapon ATK14212, visible weapon affixes ASPD74/CDM45/ATK90/LUK83, inferred +9/+8/+7/+8/+8 other refinements. Unseen armor rolls/cards/skills/Ascension are model assumptions. No claim to reproduce the screenshot HUD DPS.

All fourth jobs: level150, max ordinary inherited/class skills, 50 shared points (Might/Precision/Ferocity/Vitality/Evasion each10) and 30 class points (each upgrade rank5); legal max-budget synthetic account. Curated eligible three-star Nightmare cards, max card mastery and no pets.

Casters: corrected +15 GM presets, identical gear for INT-focused and INT/ASPD; base INT120 in both. INT-focus spends toward DEX/LUK/VIT before AGI; INT/ASPD buys AGI120 and DEX60 before the remaining priorities. There is an actual point-budget trade-off, not free AGI.

Third jobs: completed +10 N+ benchmark gear/cards/mastery; strip AGI/ASPD affixes and speed/AGI cards identically across all speeds, then purchase base AGI1/60/120 and allocate the remaining legal budget. These are speed-isolation fixtures, not claims of optimized N+ builds.
Current corrected PR101 item bases are identical on both timing sides. No gameplay tuning, caster buff, equipment-gated timing or test-limit relaxation was applied.
